messages.text: Two agency rows share an FEIN, so the broker join fans out. Confirmed against 4,213 rows: 11 pairs, all created by the same import.
The fix is a unique index on (fein, org_id) plus a merge for the existing pairs. Writing the merge as a migration so it is replayable.
Reached the 5h usage limit mid-run; the diff is stashed on the branch.
